newsitem.title: CANADA: Southam adviser values Hollinger bid.
newsitem.headline: Southam adviser values Hollinger bid.

text.p: Southam Inc's special committee of independent directors, formed to evaluate Hollinger Inc's bid for Southam, said on Friday its adviser RBC Dominion Securities Inc has valued the Hollinger bid at between C$23.55 and C$23.95 per share.
RBC Dominion Securities said fair market value of Southam shares was between C$22.25 and C$25.50, the committee said.

The board reiterated its recommendation that minority shareholders accept the bid by Hollinger's Chief Executive Conrad Black to purchase the Southam shares he does not already hold and take thej newspaper chain private.
